_about: Copy Leo has read and approved, word for word as he approved it. reviewed.test.ts holds en.json and zh.json to these texts exactly, so changing an approved line turns the suite red until the new wording has been read again and entered here. The lock is deliberate: what it keeps is the wording that was reviewed, not whatever the line says now. zh.json as a whole stays marked machine-translated; a key listed here is the exception. `approval` says how it was approved, because the two are not the same depth: "written" is Leo's own wording, "read" is copy generated to his template that he then went through line by line. docs/decisions.md D10 (round 70).

rule.makeupAir.text: {cfm} CFM. Codes may require makeup air at this airflow. California Mechanical Code §505 calls for makeup air above 400 CFM; Title 24 may also apply based on floor area.
